QuestInfo.name: [Ellin Forest] Boar Hunting
QuestInfo.1:
Destonen wants to explore Beyond the Cave, but can't because of the Boars.
Defeat #b100 each#k of #bPrimitive Boar#k and #bViolent Primitive Boar#k, then defeat their leader #bChao#k located #bDeep Inside the Cave#k.
QuestInfo.2: You hunted the Boars to help Destonen who couldn't explore Beyond the Cave because of them.

default.0: Defeat the #bPrimitive Boar#k nearby and the #bViolent Primitive Boar#k in #bBoulder Mountain Cave#k. Their leader #bChao#k is #bDeep Inside the Cave#k.
